steps.content: The patrol ship cuts through the WhiteSands. With the increasingly frequent attacks, the alert level aboard keeps rising. Everyone knows: they're closing in on their cunning quarry.
Iron Mask stands at the bow, facing the wind. His hand never leaves his weapon.
The wind howls, brewing a sandstorm, and beneath it, one can hear the whimpering of monsters.

steps.speaker: DisCorps Soldier
steps.content: Unknown biological entity detected! Dead ahead, one o'clock, in the sandstorm!
In the span of a few words, the dark shadow bursts from the sandstorm.
